main_text.p: per huic errori oppolíuit: Quale vero hoc opprobrium eft infinitæ condonantis miferationi ? quale & iuftitiæ ? Cui debetur poena nifi culpæ foli? Vnquamne poenas inflixit Deus indebitas; fæpe quidem quas meruere peccatores, quafque illis merito intermi- natus eft, remifit, nullus vn- quam quas remifit, repetijffe comperitur. Punit nos herclè Deus (caftigat potiùs) fæpe etiam fortaffe feuerius, vel poft remiffam delicti : non quo fibi de nobis fatisfiat (nam quî illi ita cordi effe poteft, nobis vt fit malè? ) fed quò nos fibi conformes efficiat,

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is visible in the left margin and was not transcribed. The word "quò" at the foot is a catchword. Some words in the text are faint, such as "Punit" (printed "Punit" with a damaged letter), and "delicti" may be "delicti" with a broken t.
